Question 10
?

sinh⁡2t=

a
12(e2t+e−2t)
b
12(e−t/2−et/2)
c
12(e−2t−e2t)
d
12(et/2−e−t/2)
e
12(e2t−e−2t)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The definition of sinh⁡x is

sinh⁡x=12(ex−e−x).

Therefore, sinh⁡2t=12(e2t−e−2t).
